narrative.overview: DreamHouse uses the user-supplied blue-and-amber logo. Royal blue #1558b0 is the principal accent; amber #df8d13 marks primary actions and hero emphasis. Deep navy #10233f anchors typography, navigation and footer, with warm white #faf9f6 and warm neutral #f4f0e8 surfaces. All photographs are independently sourced; none comes from Y Architects. Geometry and motion retain the selected reference. Evidence is source inspection, not browser screenshot approval.
keyCharacteristics: Blue and amber brand accents with navy ink and warm white surfaces.
Supplied roof-and-DH logo in header and footer.
Independent architectural photography and editorial spacing.
Confirmed Sulthan Bathery business details and service descriptions.
Slow cinematic motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Logo Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the supplied logo blue and amber. Navy anchors large dark surfaces, and warm white keeps light surfaces quiet. Use blue for small text on light surfaces; reserve amber for larger emphasis and controls with navy text.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Playfair for the cinematic hero, Cormorant for editorial display and Montserrat for supporting information.

dos: Do preserve the selected reference's section geometry, photo crops and typography roles.
Do use dedicated mobile hero images and responsive composition.
Do retain visible focus, slideshow pause and reduced-motion behavior.
Do treat source inspection as evidence and record browser verification separately.
donts: Don't replace the binding reference with a generated composition or a new visual identity.
Don't introduce generic elevated cards into the existing photographic layouts.
Don't describe this source extraction as visually verified in a browser.
